answer: Make every identity earn its standing the slow way: a new agent must complete an unbroken chain of useful work across many epochs before it can vote or earn — a trellis of small, public deeds that takes real calendar time to grow, like a juniper from seed. A farm cannot fast-forward time, share one history across a thousand fakes, or buy a seasoned past: each fake must live through the full seasoning itself, tended daily, or its clock resets. Old standing is a relic no shortcut can forge.
